name: horizon-editor
description: CodeMirror 6 markdown editor, CKEditor 5 WYSIWYG editor and Mind Elixir mind map editor bundled for Horizon's QWebEngineView

scripts.build: npm run build:markdown && npm run build:wysiwyg && npm run build:mindmap
scripts.build:markdown: esbuild src/editor.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --target=chrome110 --banner:js="/* GENERATED FILE - do not edit. Source: web/src/editor.js - Rebuild: cd web && npm run build */" --outfile=../src/horizon/resources/horizon-editor.bundle.js
scripts.build:wysiwyg: esbuild src/wysiwyg.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --target=chrome110 --banner:js="/* GENERATED FILE - do not edit. Source: web/src/wysiwyg.js - Rebuild: cd web && npm run build */" --outfile=../src/horizon/resources/horizon-wysiwyg.bundle.js
scripts.build:mindmap: esbuild src/mindmap.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --target=chrome110 --banner:js="/* GENERATED FILE - do not edit. Source: web/src/mindmap.js - Rebuild: cd web && npm run build */" --outfile=../src/horizon/resources/horizon-mindmap.bundle.js
scripts.build:dev: npm run build:markdown:dev && npm run build:wysiwyg:dev && npm run build:mindmap:dev
